name: Song of My Soul
source:
Inspired by the work of Robert W. Chambers and H.P. Lovecraft, Song of My Soul is a "dating" sim where the player attempts to win the heart of Alaric, a charming man with some potentially sinister secrets! Complete with 4 (technically 5!!) endings and a handful of branching paths, it's your job to survive this chance encounter with ideally your mind in tact.

[From [url=https://mortemania.itch.io/song-of-my-soul]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Song of My Soul》是一款受到罗伯特·W.钱伯斯与H.P.洛夫克拉夫特作品启发的“约会”模拟游戏。玩家需要设法赢得阿拉里克的心——这个魅力十足的男人，或许藏着一些不祥的秘密！游戏设有4种结局，严格来说是5种，以及若干分支路线。你的任务，就是从这场偶遇中活下来，最好还能保持神志完整。

（摘自[url=https://mortemania.itch.io/song-of-my-soul]itch.io[/url]）
